name: Pacific Catch
notes: Address confirmed as 4575 La Jolla Village Dr, San Diego (UTC), matching the work item. The restaurant's own site (pacificcatch.com) lists dish names and descriptions for this exact location but publishes no prices at all; prices came from the restaurant's order.online (DoorDash white-label) storefront for this specific store, which matched every dish name/description from the official site exactly. Cent-ending distribution (.95/.50/.00, no dominant single ending) and lack of any clean 1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25 divisor pattern indicate this is not delivery-marked-up pricing, so treated as tier 3 (checked, passing) rather than trusted outright. notes: not_found: a South Park dive bar (address confirmed, 2236 Fern St) that serves no food (bring-your-own is explicitly their policy) and has 12 drafts plus well liquor, but no priced drink or tap list exists anywhere online. The restaurant's own site has no menu page (whistlestopbar.com/menu and /drinks both 404), and searches only surface generic happy-hour discount amounts ('$1 off taps & spirits'), not actual prices for any named drink.
